baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence تَعَالَوْا, يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ, لَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ, and يَصُدُّونَ turns an offered remedy into a refused movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: An ascent-derived summons asks them to approach the messenger so that fault can be covered and its consequence warded off. The head twists off-line and the continuing turn blocks that remedial path; self-magnification supplies the opposing force.

activation_trace.role: The ascent-derived call literally summons approach and makes repair a movement toward the messenger.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from the result supplies the remedy at the end of the approach.
The bearer of a message is also the named mediator around whom the offered repair is organized.
Literal torsion of the head gives the refusal a visible change of direction.
Turning away or turning another aside extends the instant gesture into an ongoing blockage.
Self-exaltation supplies the force that resists the invitation's directed movement.

changed_reading.before: They rudely refuse an invitation to have forgiveness requested for them.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages repair as a traversable approach, and their bodies turn away at its threshold because performed greatness will not enter a path of received protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive قِيلَ is answered not by quoted words but by head movement under وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken proposal opens one channel, while a signaling twist and visible withdrawal answer on another. Because a thing's indication can function as its saying, the body becomes a counter-utterance that is more legible than any verbal reply.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the invitation to which the later bodily sequence responds.
A thing's indication functioning as its saying licenses the head gesture as meaningful counter-speech.
Signaling with a raised object or limb makes the twist communicative rather than merely kinetic.
Direct sight makes their unspoken answer publicly readable.
The continuing turn supplies the semantic content of the gestural answer: refusal and obstruction.

changed_reading.before: Speech is followed by a contemptuous motion.
changed_reading.after: The scene is a two-channel exchange: the invitation speaks toward reconciliation, while their visible torsion speaks a sustained no.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَعَالَوْا carries an elevation-derived approach, رُءُوسَهُمْ names the bodily top, and مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ names claimed greatness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah arranges a vertical dispute. A call associated with true rising is refused by rotating the body's top away, while self-exaltation constructs a rival height that cannot accept mediated repair.

activation_trace.role: Elevation and honor remain latent inside the summons and establish the positive vertical pole.
The head as bodily top materializes rank and orientation at the point of refusal.
Turning off the intended direction converts claimed height into directional refusal.
Arrogant greatness provides the counterfeit vertical pole competing with the summons.

changed_reading.before: Their pride makes them reject help.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal contests where height resides: they preserve a self-made elevation by turning the bodily top away from the approach that could actually raise their condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier verbal testimony is countered and named false; in the focus ayah, speech again opens the scene but sight receives the decisive evidence. The signaling body becomes an involuntary witness against the speakers' managed words.

activation_trace.role: Indication functioning as speech lets the visible gesture bear propositional force.
The signaling branch makes the head motion an unintended declaration.
Eyewitness perception receives the bodily evidence that words attempted to manage.
The tongue as witness supplies the formal testimony whose credibility the visible body later defeats.
Falsehood supplies the prior verdict that makes involuntary bodily evidence newly diagnostic.

structural_cues: 63:1 pairs their spoken testimony with God's counter-testimony and calls them liars; 63:5 pairs what is said to them with what is visibly done by them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies managed testimony, a falsehood verdict, signaling torsion, and seeing; I infer that the body functions as an unplanned witness. A live alternative is simple dramatic contrast without evidentiary force.

changed_reading.before: Their gesture is a nonverbal reply.
changed_reading.after: Their gesture is also counter-testimony: when their tongue is unreliable, the body visibly testifies to the orientation their words conceal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers a covering that protects the wrongdoer from the fault's consequence. The earlier sequence shows them constructing a different protection from oaths and then turning or blocking. Their refusal is therefore not aversion to protection as such, but preference for a self-made verbal shield over received forgiveness.

activation_trace.role: A covering that preserves what it covers supplies the material logic of offered protection.
Covering fault and warding off its effect specifies the protection they are invited to receive.
The oath supplies the verbal material from which their alternative protection is made.
A protective shield makes those oaths function as manufactured cover.
The repeated turn or obstruction links their shield-making directly to the focus refusal.

structural_cues: 63:2 sequences oath-taking, shield, and turning; 63:5 sequences invitation, offered forgiveness, head-twist, and continuing turning.
Both protections are mediated through speech, but only one requires approach and acknowledgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two coverings and repeated turning; I infer that they are rival protective strategies. The alternative is that the oath-shield merely characterizes prior conduct without functioning as a substitute for forgiveness.

changed_reading.before: They reject the protection offered through forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: They choose between protections, keeping the oath-shield they control and turning away from the forgiving cover that would expose fault before covering it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A stamped heart and the root-image of reversal precede a question about being turned from one's direction. The focus then makes that orientation kinetic: an inner fixity appears at the head and continues as active withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Physical torsion externalizes a directional state in the visible body.
Continuing withdrawal carries the momentary twist into stable orientation.
Stamping and sealing supply the fixity that makes the later movement symptomatic rather than incidental.
The heart supplies the interior site whose orientation the body discloses.
Turning a thing away from its face overlays the named heart with a latent reversal.
Being turned from a proper direction supplies the immediate contextual hinge into the focus body's turn.

structural_cues: 63:3 locates fixity in the heart, 63:4 ends by asking how they are turned, and 63:5 displays a head turning before an ongoing withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seal, heart, reversal, bodily torsion, and continuing withdrawal; I infer an inside-to-outside diagnostic arrow. The alternative is that the gesture is only a fresh act of contempt, not an exterior trace of prior inner fixation.

changed_reading.before: The head turn expresses present arrogance.
changed_reading.after: The head turn is the visible kinematics of an already fixed inward reversal: the body diagrams the direction of the sealed heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated seeing frame carries the prior image of impressive bodies as propped timber into the focus. The head's twist can then be read as the limited articulation of a supported facade: conspicuous exterior motion without inward responsiveness.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight frames the head movement as inspected bodily evidence.
The literal twist provides the moving joint in the material analogy.
The earlier matching act of sight joins the two bodily observations into one visual field.
The gathered, perceptible body establishes the exterior object under inspection.
Rigid, gathered timber supplies the material behavior transferred to the visible bodies.
Dependence on an external support makes the impressive facade structurally unresponsive on its own.

structural_cues: 63:4 and 63:5 repeat the second-person seeing of the same plural object, first as bodies and then as moving heads.
The timber comparison immediately precedes the focus scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated visual syntax, bodies, rigid timber, support, and torsion; I carry the material analogy one ayah forward. The live alternative is that the timber image ends in 63:4 and should not govern the next gesture.

changed_reading.after: Alongside deliberate disdain, the gesture can look mechanically revealing: a polished, externally supported body can swivel its top yet cannot bend inward toward repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus presents a directed invitation to seek intercession; the next ayah equates intercession and its absence and repeats forgiveness under negation. Read sequentially, the visible refusal marks the last open-looking fork before both options collapse into the same result.

activation_trace.role: Forgiveness as protection from a fault's effect is the live-looking outcome held out in the invitation.
Equality between two alternatives collapses the apparent fork opened in the focus scene.
The repeated seek, not-seek, and not-forgive sequence closes the protective outcome just offered.

structural_cues: 63:6 immediately follows the refused imperative of 63:5 and balances seeking forgiveness against not seeking it before a categorical negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invitation followed by equalized alternatives and negated forgiveness; I infer a closing-window function for the refusal. The live alternative is that 63:6 only discloses a condition already settled, so 63:5 reveals rather than causes closure.

changed_reading.before: They decline one available route to forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: The refusal occupies a temporal hinge: they visibly reject the route while it is staged as approachable, just before the text declares the route and its absence outcome-equivalent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks bodies to move toward the messenger, while 63:7 withholds monetary outflow to force the people already near him to flow apart. The head-turn is one local instance of a larger counterflow regime: block resources, reverse approach, and produce dispersal.

activation_trace.role: The call to approach supplies the centripetal movement opposed by the later policy.
Turning away and obstructing names the local reversal of that approach.
The messenger is the shared center toward which one group is called and around which another is gathered.
Money going out makes withheld expenditure the control valve for intended human outflow.
Nearness and presence locate the people whom the policy aims to dislodge from the messenger.
A gathering breaking apart supplies the intended social result of withholding outflow.

structural_cues: The focus says come toward the messenger; 63:7 names those present with the messenger and a plan to make them disperse.
The economic prohibition precedes the intended social breakup in one causal sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, obstruction, withheld expenditure, proximity, and dispersal; I infer that economic flow is being used to engineer bodily flow. The alternative is that the focus gesture and the later policy are parallel refusals without one shared circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They personally turn away from the messenger's invitation.
changed_reading.after: Their bodily turn belongs to a social technology of counter-movement: refuse approach themselves and manipulate provision so that those already near the messenger are driven outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later boast maps honor onto the power to return, expel, and assign others the lower place. That status geography sharpens the focus verticality: they reject an approach to the messenger because it would surrender their claim to direct who moves toward, within, or out of the community.

activation_trace.role: Elevation and honor inside the summons establish the rank they refuse to receive through approach.
The bodily top gives the dispute over rank a visible spatial instrument.
Self-exaltation supplies the claimed rank from which they refuse the invitation.
Return to a prior place opens the boast's contested civic space.
Forcing passage to the outside turns rank into control over another's location.
Dominance and overpowering supply the asserted rank, while the repeated root lets the ayah reassign its ownership.
Subjection under force supplies the lower position they project onto the group to be expelled.

structural_cues: 63:5 coordinates come, head, and self-exaltation; 63:8 coordinates return, expel, mighty, abased, and a correction about where honor belongs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two movement scenes saturated with vertical rank; I infer that accepting intercession would concede their rival map of authority. The alternative is that arrogance is only an affective cause and the later expulsion boast is a separate political expression.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance blocks a request for forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: The refusal is a jurisdictional act: self-appointed rank turns the head away from a messenger-centered order because approaching would yield control over honor and communal placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A form-distant branch of the focus head-twist names delaying a debt despite ability to pay. The closing ayat stage a person asking for delay when a near fixed term has arrived and then deny any postponement. This activates the focus refusal as embodied deferment of moral liability: settlement through forgiveness is postponed until postponement is impossible.

activation_trace.role: Delaying payment of an owed debt supplies the exploratory temporal and juridical image inside the bodily turn.
Protection from a fault's consequence supplies the settlement they decline to seek now.
Loss of life supplies the boundary after which the delayed settlement cannot be enacted.
A plea to move action to a later time verbalizes the postponement latent in the focus branch.
A fixed temporal limit turns deferment into a closing liability.
The nearness of time compresses the imagined extension requested at death.
The categorical denial of later postponement closes the temporal maneuver activated by the focus twist.
Arrival of the appointed limit makes the earlier opportunity nonrenewable.

structural_cues: 63:5 offers action in the present; 63:10 voices a later plea for postponement; 63:11 denies postponement once the term arrives.
The focus l-w-y inventory itself contains both bodily twisting and solvent debt-delay branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a debt-delay branch, present refusal, later postponement language, and a fixed term; I infer moral liability and settlement as the bridge. The live alternative is that debt-delay is only a remote lexical neighbor and the focus remains purely gestural.

changed_reading.before: They turn away from remedy in the present.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the twist enacts moral deferment: they roll an answerable liability forward until the closing ayat expose a term at which no further delay can be granted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from juridical covering to a botanical peel. It remains anchored in the focus offer of protective covering and ongoing withdrawal, while 63:6 names the group with a root whose only supplied branch is emergence from a shell. Render it only as a material analogy for self-exposure, not as the lexical gloss of فَاسِقِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The offered يَسْتَغْفِرْ covering is immediately refused through يَصُدُّونَ.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the enclosure into which the invitation could bring them.
Ongoing withdrawal supplies the motion away from that enclosure.
A ripe fruit exiting its peel supplies the cross-domain image of leaving protective containment.

changed_reading.before: They remain outside an offered forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, their turning is active self-uncovering: they emerge from the very protective enclosure they are summoned to receive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grammatical heads are ordinary body parts and no leaders are named in 63:5. It remains anchored in the root's supplied headship branch, the plural coordinated turn, and later programs of dispersal and dominance. Render it as a social-scale structural echo, not as a claim that رُءُوسَهُمْ literally means chiefs here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural رُءُوسَهُمْ turns before the plural ongoing يَصُدُّونَ.

activation_trace.role: Headship and precedence scale the bodily top into an exploratory image of collective direction.
Twisting opponents' necks in contention supplies an adversarial command image within the head-turn.
Turning oneself or others aside lets elite orientation propagate into group obstruction.
Breaking a gathering apart supplies the later collective effect of directed refusal.
Dominance and overpowering supply the political force by which a directing head imagines moving others.

changed_reading.before: Several individuals turn their heads away together.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the synchronized heads expose a command layer: claimed leaders orient the social body away, then scale that orientation into dispersal and expulsion.

strongest_changes: 63:1 makes the visible head-turn an involuntary testimony against managed speech.
63:2 turns the refusal into a choice between an oath-made shield and forgiveness-made covering.
63:3-4 recast the bodily twist as both an exterior trace of inward reversal and, separately, the articulation of a propped facade.
63:7-8 scale personal withdrawal into resource-controlled dispersal and a rival geography of rank.
63:6 and 63:10-11 make the scene a closing temporal fork, with a live but exploratory debt-delay resonance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah remained simultaneously a remedial threshold, a two-channel speech event, a vertical status contest, an inside-out diagnostic, and a node in social and temporal counterflow; the context sharpened these without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: 63:6 may disclose a closure already fixed rather than make the refusal in 63:5 its causal hinge.
The timber mechanics may be intentionally carried by the repeated seeing syntax, or the comparison may end strictly in 63:4.
Debt-delay, shell-exit, and collective-headship should remain qualified analogies rather than lexical substitutions.
